title: Local constraints are where the future arrives
summary: A qualitative dependency map showing how compute, chips, power, water, housing, and permit signals become local outcomes only through source-backed receiving systems.
map_question: Which dependencies convert frontier compute and chip signals into local outcomes, and where does the evidence still stop short?
interpretation_boundary: This map shows qualitative relationships among existing FTFN records. It does not prove local readiness, project viability, facility capacity, or completed outcomes.

nodes.label: AI compute demand
nodes.note: Compute growth creates demand for power, cooling, grid interconnection, and local siting evidence.

nodes.label: U.S. Southwest Chip Corridor
nodes.note: A receiving system where compute and semiconductor signals meet water, power, labor, and infrastructure constraints.

nodes.label: Power capacity
nodes.note: Utility filings, interconnection, tariffs, and service-territory evidence are still needed.

nodes.label: Water capacity
nodes.note: Provider-level water records, facility demand, reuse, and permits are still needed.

nodes.label: Grid-scale energy storage
nodes.note: Storage may support flexibility and reliability but does not replace utility planning evidence.

nodes.label: Ontario Real Estate
nodes.note: A receiving system where housing targets, permits, starts, completions, capital, and municipal infrastructure determine outcomes.

nodes.label: Housing target conversion
nodes.note: Municipal servicing, approvals, and infrastructure capacity remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Permit-to-completion conversion
nodes.note: Starts, completions, cancellations, financing, and local absorption evidence are still needed.

links.note: AI compute and semiconductor signals matter locally only where power, water, land, and permitting systems can absorb them.
State electricity context exists, but project-level utility capacity evidence is missing.
Arizona water governance context exists, but facility/provider-level capacity evidence is missing.
Storage may become part of the power-capacity stack, but this map does not prove local deployment or interconnection readiness.
Provincial housing progress context exists, but local municipal conversion evidence remains incomplete.
Permits and starts/completions evidence exist, but geography-specific conversion and financing evidence remain incomplete.

what_this_map_supports: FTFN can show where reviewed signals meet local receiving systems.
FTFN can identify which relationships are supported by current sources and which remain evidence gaps.
The dependency-stack thesis can be represented without numeric scoring.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not prove local readiness for semiconductor, AI, storage, or housing outcomes.
It does not resolve power, water, municipal servicing, permit conversion, or financing evidence gaps.
It does not rank local systems or create a 42/59 score.
next_records_needed: Specific utility filings or interconnection records for gap-001.
Provider and facility water records for gap-002.
Municipal servicing and approval-timeline records for gap-004.
Geography-specific starts, completions, financing, and absorption records for gap-005.
